explanation: Use Euclid’s identity gcd(x,y)=gcd(y,x mod y) until the second operand is zero. BigInt preserves the full integer precision of the advertised long inputs.
timeComplexity: O(log(max(x,y))) remainder operations for nonzero inputs; BigInt remainder cost depends on operand bit length.
attribution: JavaScript port of the independently authored EPI Practice C# algorithm; no upstream reference code copied.
